name: Camping Seemühle
beschreibung: The campsite Camping Seemühle is located in Kössen in the Tyrolean lowlands. Situated right by the lake, the park offers pleasant pitches for motorhomes and tents. The sanitary facilities are modern and fully accessible. Guests can enjoy regional specialties at the neighbouring restaurant. In the immediate surroundings, scenic hiking and cycle trails invite outdoor adventures into the Tyrolean mountains.
